content: {"phoneNote":"Phone first screen works: the food photo leads, headline sits at a comfortable size, but the two hero links read as plain underlined text rather than a clear primary action.","desktopNote":"Desktop first screen is sound, but the page below has a wide empty right half beside the menu list and a huge footer wordmark that dwarfs the content.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":4,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":4,"spacing":2,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Fill the empty right column beside the desktop menu list (second photo, opening hours or a map) or centre/narrow the section so it doesn't leave a dead band.","Make 'Pokličite nas' a real button on phone and in the dark CTA band; the two text links there repeat the hero pair and footer phone, so drop one pair.","Shrink the footer wordmark on both screens; it is larger than the hero headline and pushes the actual contact details far down."],"blockers":[]}
